claims.statement: Alarm lot LOT-1239 measured 521.38 outside spec 485.0-515.0
CLN02 lot at 67.5 measured 501.77 then later CLN02 lots at 69.6 measured 520.81 and at 72.0 measured 521.38
CLN01 lots stayed normal with lot at 69.0 measuring 499.26 and lot at 70.8 measuring 500.02
High lots at 69.6 measured 520.81 and at 71.4 measured 520.73 and at 72.0 measured 521.38 ran on different chambers DEP01-A DEP02-A DEP01-B and on MET01 and MET02
Commonality over 17 lots in 12.0 hours shows CLN01 mean 499.85 for 7 lots and CLN02 mean 506.56 for 10 lots with overall mean 503.79

disposition.summary: Three consecutive CLN02 lots jumped to about 521 while CLN01 lots stayed near 500. The highs span three deposition chambers and both metrology tools, so the CLEAN step is the common source. Hold the alarm lot and escalate CLN02.

notes.text: Starting on ALM-01486 for LOT-1239 — pulling the alarm details.
Alarm is out-of-spec high at 521.38 — checking that lot's history to form hypotheses.
Three high outliers across different chambers and metrology tools share the same clean tool — digging into that pattern.
The evidence points to an upstream CLN02 issue — filing the disposition.
Needs a commonality citation — amending the disposition.

truth.explanation: CLN02 started leaving the surface in a state that deposits thick in the center, on every chamber.

public: US Patent 8,718,809, Comprehensive analysis of queue times in microelectronic manufacturing
Film growth can be influenced by the pre-clean to deposition queue time.
Chien, Wang, Cheng (2007), Data mining for yield enhancement in semiconductor manufacturing, Expert Systems with Applications 33(1)
Statistical tests over process history point to the tools behind an excursion, the idea behind commonality analysis.
sources.practitioner: Equipment or upstream problems are suspected when abnormal lots cluster in one group. One contact called upstream and shared-facility effects very frequent; the other thought them rare. We keep the scenario and note the disagreement.
